name: auto-handoff
description: Writes a handoff by itself shortly before the prompt cache of an idle session expires, while the cache is still warm. Runs its own /auto-handoff:handoff skill and saves its answer under ~/.claude/handoffs, or another installed handoff command you pick once. Nothing in the handoff waits for approval: calls that would prompt are declined, never approved. A row above the prompt counts down; /auto-handoff opens a pane with the timeline, which command runs and why, and buttons to hand off now, pause, re-pick or copy the path.

handoffCommand.title: Handoff command
handoffCommand.description: The slash command that writes the handoff, without the slash, e.g. "compound-engineering:ce-handoff". Empty (default): the built-in /auto-handoff:handoff, and after your first turn auto-handoff offers any other installed handoff skill once. A command that is not installed falls back to the built-in.

cacheMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (min)
cacheMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives after a request: 60 on a Claude subscription, 5 on an API key or usage credits.

leadMinutes.title: Hand off before expiry (min)
leadMinutes.description: Run the handoff this many minutes before the cache expires, so the handoff turn starts while the cache is warm.

enabled.title: Auto handoff
enabled.description: Off: auto-handoff never fires by itself; /auto-handoff now still runs it.

showBand.title: Band row above the prompt
showBand.description: Show the handoff countdown in a row above the prompt. Off: no row; /auto-handoff still opens the pane, and the status line still counts down the last minute.
